name: cloud
notes: Domain-warped cloud: the soft cumulus spectrum resampled through a low-frequency displacement - advected billows. The un-warped variant lives on in this spec's history; the warped field won review as the more cloud-like. Levels 30/55/80 = light/medium/heavy, calibrated to core-band stroke coverage by tools/fractal-tip.mjs --calibrate; verified by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs. REVISED to a TONAL mask on a deep, fully scattered train (docs §6). As a coverage cut on a shallow scattered train this was the collection's worst splotcher - the stamp count wandered and the union filled unevenly (ripple 9-11%, comb 18-24% of tone). The overlap budget fixes it, and this texture can afford it: a union of binary sets fills rather than averages, but a tonal mask accumulates the GEOMETRIC MEAN of the stamps' damage, and the average of independent windows of a Gaussian field is the same field - so the phase mush that would ruin a faceted texture costs a billowy one nothing. Dual spacing 0.33 -> 0.07 (n=12) with scatter kept at 0.7; scatterDeconv back on, since a wide kernel really does smear; tonal.gain 3 restores the log-contrast the deep average costs (about the geometric mean, so the tone stays put) and tonal.floor 0.02 stops a single stamp's field minimum from punching a full-ink speck through the stack. Levels 30/55/80 are now damage DEPTH, not coverage.
